summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Play2Learn educational app enhancements - Global navigation, 4 games expansion, mascot helper, audio system, and enhanced UX features all working correctly

integration_issues.issue: Homepage uses 'quizzes' in data-testid but navigation expects 'quiz'
integration_issues.workaround: Direct navigation works, only affects automated testing

passed_tests: Home page loads with correct title and category cards
Global navigation bar with Back button, Home link, and icon navigation
All 4 games accessible from games menu (Memory Match, Letter Catch, Count Objects, Shape Match)
Games menu mascot helper appears and can be closed
Memory Match game: 12 cards, restart functionality, card clicking mechanics
Letter Catch game: Start screen, target letter display, falling letters mechanism
Count Objects game: Start screen, question display, answer options
Shape Match game: Complete navigation and start screen
Quiz functionality: Category selection, question display, answer submission, next question navigation
Alphabets page: Letter cards clickable, detail view with speak button
Numbers page: Number cards clickable, detail view with speak button
About page: All required content sections present, Start Learning button navigation
Navigation persistence: Star counter and sound toggle visible across all pages
Exit buttons in all games return to games menu correctly
Audio system buttons are clickable (actual audio requires user interaction)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix minor selector inconsistency: Homepage quiz category uses 'quizzes' in data-testid but should be 'quiz' for consistency. Very low priority as functionality works correctly.
